intro: Messenger to Westfall is an Alliance errand carrying an urgent plea from Magistrate Solomon in Redridge across Elwynn to Westfall. Facing total abandonment by the Stormwind military, Lakeshire's leadership seeks mutual aid from Gryan Stoutmantle's newly formed People's Militia.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Something odd is afoot with the Stormwind Army. They should have been here in force by now. Time is a luxury we don't have, however. I will not stand by and watch the people of Lakeshire give their lives without trying to enlist more help. I've heard word of a people's militia forming in Westfall.
Take this plea to their leader, Gryan Stoutmantle. Perhaps Stoutmantle's men can lend some support here until the King sends reserves.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hail, warrior. What business do you have with The People's Militia?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Good Messenger, you have served your master well.
